newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Three Moroccan cement companies merge.
newsitem.headline: Three Moroccan cement companies merge.

text.p: Morocco cement firms Cinouca, Cadem and Lafarge Maroc have merged to create a company to be known as Lafarge Ciment, official said on Tuesday.

Lafarge Ciment aims to cut cement production costs by up to 15 percent and to have turnover of more than $230 million, Lafarge's deputy chairman, M'Fadel Lahlou, said at a news conference at which he announced the merger.
"The merger will help improve the group industry efficiency, developing new activities and generating financial synergy," he said.
